title: stable rank-placement sort of 8 values (negatives, duplicates): ordering, multiplicity, count, sum, extremes

provenance.author: DRPLi E2E-50/P2 step 4 corpus
provenance.note: written for this project; independently specified; no third-party import

notes:
Reference sequence is Python's OWN sorted multiset (reference.py:table01) -
the PL/I rank-placement algorithm is under test, never the reference. The two
duplicates (-3 twice, 7 twice) must both appear (multiplicity); SUM= 25 and
N= 8 over the sorted table prove no slot was overwritten or lost (rank
collisions would duplicate or drop an element). Nested indexed DO is the
times-two composition of the measured LOOP.DO_TO_BY shape. Scalar compares only
(G114B-backed strict relations); array-element compares (AB11/LR9 refusals),
>=, <= (COND.GE_LE), literal-left (COND.LITERAL_LEFT), multidim, K_PLUS_X and
traversal reload are deliberately absent. Compile-checked at authoring against
the current binary: 1536-byte .REL (code=627 data=50).
